title: Two-Variable Compressions of Shifts, Toeplitz Operators, and Numerical Ranges
summary: This paper studies two-variable compressions of shifts associated to rational inner functions on the bidisk; these generalize the classical compressions of the shift associated to finite Blasckhe products and are unitarily equivalent to one-variable, matrix-valued Toeplitz operators. This paper proves that a rational inner function is almost completely determined by these Toeplitz operator symbols but provides examples showing that (unlike in the one-variable case) rational inner functions are not determined by the numerical ranges of their compressed shifts.
